nodes.name: en.json
nodes.summary: English localization dictionary for the Instagram CRM channel UI, holding 66 translation keys for connection states, notices, actions, and setup steps.
nodes.languageNotes: Flat key/value JSON locale bundle; key names are shared verbatim across the en/ru/uz sibling files.

nodes.name: ru.json
nodes.summary: Russian localization dictionary for the Instagram CRM channel UI, mirroring the same 66 keys for connection badges, status leads, notices, and onboarding steps.
nodes.languageNotes: Default UI language for the project; structurally identical to en.json and uz.json.

nodes.name: uz.json
nodes.summary: Uzbek localization dictionary for the Instagram CRM channel UI, providing the same 66 translation keys used to render connection, error, and disconnect flows.
nodes.languageNotes: Completes the en/ru/uz locale set; all three share an identical key schema.
